notes.subject: sira
notes.rationale: תקות ka kɔrɔ literal ye kabakolo ye (min bɛ mara); a fɔcogo Bamanankan na 'sira' (sensɛn) — a kɔrɔ fanga ye laadali ye

notes.subject: ⟨nin⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan tɛ daɲɛ nɔnabila sɔrɔ; Bamanankan ka mago bɛ a la kuma kɔnɔ

notes.subject: laadali/sira
notes.rationale: Heburukan bɛ daɲɛ fila dii minnu bɛ fɔ ka kɛ kelen ye (תוחלת/תקוה) — jujɔ-jujɔ cogo min bɛ Bamanankan na, o dɔgɔya dɔɔni

translation: Mɔgɔ senumaw ka laadali ye diya ye, nka mɔgɔ juguw ka sira ⟨nin⟩ bɛna yɛlɛ.
